title: E0071: Unsafe file upload
plain_english: Storing uploaded files without validating their type, extension, or destination can allow an attacker to upload executable code to the server.
why_matters: An attacker who can upload a `.php` file and access it through the web server may be able to: - Execute arbitrary code - Gain control of the server - Use the uploaded file as a foothold for further attacks
what_it_checks: `move_uploaded_file()` without prior extension or MIME validation
`$_FILES['name']` used directly in file paths without sanitization
